name: straw-boss
description: Herdr-backed dispatch for Claude Code: a boss triages any work — implementation, audit, research, diagnosis — to a plain subagent or a session actually rooted in an app's own directory (headless `claude -p`, or an interactive herdr pane) so its own CLAUDE.md/rules/skills/hooks load the way they would for any developer working there directly, with a standardized git lifecycle and an authorization gate on every push/merge. Works directly in a single-app repo, or routes across a monorepo's apps first.
